description: Build multimodal AI applications with Pixeltable.

defaultPrompt: Build a RAG app over my documents, images, and videos
Turn this AI pipeline into one declarative Pixeltable app
Take this Pixeltable app from local development to Cloud
interface.longDescription: Build multimodal AI backends in one Python file. Pixeltable combines database, orchestration, indexing, and serving for images, video, audio, documents, and model outputs. Define transformations as computed columns in the schema; insert a row and the dependent pipeline runs incrementally. Run the same declarative app locally or on Pixeltable Cloud.
